label: Truth-preserving retagging changes content identity while records stay true
paraphrase: On the same tagged-Boolean semantics and actual source tokens, the retagging channel satisfies RECORD_TRANSPORT_2 but fails RECORD_TRANSPORT_1. Every original content differs from its retagged content while their truth at that history agrees; causal record coverage and true decoded records persist. The tag is a structural content-identity surrogate, not a complete account of psychological content.
